newsitem.title: CHINA: CNT places HK$118 mln new shrs to parent.
newsitem.headline: CNT places HK$118 mln new shrs to parent.

text.p: CNT Group Ltd said controlling shareholder Rapid Growth Ltd would subscribe 98 million new company shares for about HK$118.08 million after it placed the same amount of old shares to a third party at HK$1.21 per share.
The company said Rapid Growth would place the existing shares to third party Broadsino Investment Ltd (BIC).
On completion of the deal, Rapid Growth and its subsidiary Citybus Finance Co Ltd will hold about 47.9 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, down from 51.64 percent.
BIC is a unit of Jiangsu provincial government-controlled Jiangsu International Trust and Investment Corporation (JITIC), the largest provincial trust and investment corporation in China.
CNT said Rapid Growth would not be under any obligation to make a general offer for the company shares.
Trading in CNT shares, which had been suspended since July 15, resumed trading on Monday. The shares rose HK$0.05 to HK$1.49 at midsession.
